title.zh: Attackers exploit fake STM32 vulnerability alert to target Trezor and BitBox holders
title.en: Attackers exploit fake STM32 vulnerability alert to target Trezor and BitBox holders

current_state.zh: Trezor and BitBox warned users about phishing emails impersonating their brands after suspected breaches at third-party email and newsletter providers, with a fake 'STM32 Entropy Vulnerability' alert designed to trick recipients into compromising their recovery seeds.
